policy_scope.note: Do not mix with current ROS oftplus_h5_proprio deployment results.

baseline.description: Baseline real collection. Original cube layout, original lighting, no extra object. Sim replay for episode4 is the fixed sim reference.

new_real_conditions.description: Same cube layout as episode4, but real lighting condition changed. Sim image/reference remains episode4.
Orange target and trajectory are kept as episode4, while blue and yellow cube positions are changed in real. Sim image/reference remains episode4.
Based on episode9 real condition, with an additional non-cube object added. Sim image/reference remains episode4.

primary_comparisons.purpose: Sim-real gap under real lighting change.
Sim-real gap under non-target cube layout change.
Sim-real gap under non-target cube layout change plus extra object.
Real-only shift from lighting-changed condition to non-target cube layout change condition.

interpretation_rules: Sim image/reference is intentionally fixed to episode4 for the new conditions.
Sim4-vs-changed-real comparisons measure how far changed real observations move away from the fixed sim reference.
Real-vs-real comparisons are required to attribute changes to lighting, non-target cube layout, or extra object.
Observation or representation distribution shift must not be interpreted as policy impact unless action-facing/action metrics support it.
No Shadow Mode or closed-loop rollout result should be claimed unless corresponding logs exist.
